# `company.bank_rules`

Bank inbox rules, written or learned: which lines each fits and what it proposes; an auto-add or ignore rule acts on its own only while live. Never deleted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this rule. |
| `name` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | Its name, as shown with every line it proposes for. |
| `name_key` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | ux_bank_rules_name | — | The name case-folded, unique. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_bank_rules_account | accounts.id | The feed account it applies to; null for every feed account. |
| `direction` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Lines it fits: in, out, any (money in, money out, either). |
| `conditions` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON array of conditions, all of which must hold: field (payee, payee_key, memo, number, amount), op (contains, starts_with, equals, between), value and, for between, value_to. Text is compared case-folded with spaces collapsed; no regular expressions. |
| `action` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | What it does: categorise, transfer, ignore. |
| `payee_type` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Categorise: the list the payee is on. |
| `payee_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Categorise: the payee (a customer, vendor, employee or other name). |
| `payee` | VARCHAR(1000) | yes | — | — | — | — | Categorise: the payee as shown; null when the rule names none. |
| `category_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | accounts.id | Categorise: the account an added line goes to. |
| `class_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | classes.id | Categorise: the class an added line takes. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Categorise: the memo an added line takes; null keeps the bank's text. |
| `transfer_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | accounts.id | Transfer: the other account of the transfer. |
| `ignore_reason` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Ignore: the reason (already_entered, not_ours, duplicate, other). |
| `auto_add` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | 1 when the rule asks to add its lines unattended (a categorise rule); it acts only while live. |
| `priority` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Lower is tried first; written rules default to 100, learned rules to 1000. |
